text:
Jared L.: Quick heads up — effective June 1 we’re launching a PTO Donation Pool and a short-term Emergency Leave (TEL) program for people impacted by acute disasters (wildfires, floods, major storms). Full policy + FAQ: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/pto-donation-tel

Priya S.: thanks! how does the donation pool work in practice? can managers donate too?

People Ops: Good Q. Donation pool basics: team members may donate up to 3 PTO days/year into a central pool. Managers can donate on behalf of their teams but donations must be voluntary (no pressure). People affected by a qualifying event can request up to 10 days from the pool per 12-month rolling period.

Tess M.: What counts as a qualifying event? is there proof needed?

People Ops: Qualifying events are defined in the policy: declared natural disasters, verified home loss, or serious family medical emergency. We ask for basic verification (insurance claim, local authority notice, or HR intake form). People Ops will treat documentation sensitively.

Priya S.: Any tax implications for donors/recipients?

People Ops: In most jurisdictions donations are a transfer of paid time off and not taxable income to the recipient. However, tax rules vary by country. We’ve added a short tax guidance section per region on the policy page. For complex cases Finance will consult.

Jared L.: How do we apply? manager approval or central review?

People Ops: Employees submit a request in Workday > Time Off > Emergency Leave Request. Manager does a preliminary confirm of need; People Ops runs final eligibility and release of pooled days. We aim to process within 2 business days for urgent cases.

Global Mobility Bot: :earth_americas: Note: International employees — some countries restrict PTO transfers. See country exceptions list on the policy page. The bot will DM people in impacted locations with next steps.

Tess M.: Is this compatible with the existing bereavement top-up and caregiving funds?

People Ops: Yes. Donation pool is separate from bereavement and caregiver top-ups. You can’t double-dip for the same incident (we coordinate benefits to avoid overlap).

Priya S.: Are donated days visible on my timesheet after I donate?

People Ops: Donated days will show as a PTO adjustment in Workday with a note "Donation Pool". Donor names are not disclosed to recipients.

Jared L.: If I donate and later need the days back for myself, is there a reversal?

People Ops: Donations are final. We recommend donators keep at least a 5-day buffer. If you have an emergency after donating, contact People Ops — we escalate on a case-by-case basis.

Priya S.: Pilot length? will this be permanent?

People Ops: We’re piloting June 1 to Dec 31. We’ll share utilization metrics mid-pilot (Aug) and a final review in Jan. If it performs well we plan to make it permanent with minor updates.

Tess M.: Any changes to travel support for disasters? (like emergency reroutes or lodging)

People Ops: Yes — for employees displaced while traveling on company business we’ve updated Travel Emergency support: Emergency rebooking and 5 nights of company-covered lodging if needed. File a Concur incident and tag People Ops; our travel partner will assist.

Global Mobility Bot: :white_check_mark: Travel emergency policy updated: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/travel-emergency. Concur will show an "Emergency Assistance" button for bookings after June 1.

Jared L.: Will managers get a short briefing?

People Ops: We’re running two 30-min manager syncs next week (May 20 & May 22 @ 9am PT). Agenda: how to handle requests, privacy, and reporting. Recording and a manager TL;DR will be posted in #managers.

Priya S.: Can we run internal comms for global offices? need translations maybe

People Ops: Yes — local comms kit + 3 translations (ES, FR, PT-BR) are being prepared. Will drop into #announcements and People Ops will ping leads in affected regions.

Tess M.: Thanks — appreciate the quick rollout.

People Ops: Thanks all. If you have specific edge cases DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com. We’ll open an inbox specifically for donation pool requests on June 1.
